riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: This career fits people who combine precision, practicality, and field readiness. Drawings must be accurate, measurements must reflect actual conditions, and you must handle the job site.
riasec_fit_block.interest: This career tests whether you can align drawings with actual conditions. You need technical calculations and software skills, plus a willingness to work on site and handle demanding conditions. It suits practical, detail-oriented people who are comfortable on construction sites.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Prefers practical work, investigation, and order (Realistic R + Investigative I + Conventional C).

breadcrumb.label: 土木工程技师与技术员

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行适合把「细致 + 踏实 + 能跑」凑一块的人——图要算得准，地也要量得实，现场还要扛得住。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行最练「图与地的对得上」——既要懂计算和软件，也要肯下现场、吃得苦。适合踏实、细致、也愿意跑工地的人。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 偏好务实、钻研、也守规（现实 R + 研究 I + 常规 C）。

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: This career suits people who combine strong logic, exacting standards, and sustained focus, then use those traits to clean data across a sea of tables.
riasec_fit_block.interest: Accuracy is the hardest standard in this field. One missing entry or incorrect code can force an entire database to be reworked. The job suits steady, exacting people who can find contradictions across extensive tables. Logic and patience are essential.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Prefers orderly, rule-based work and investigation (Conventional C + Investigative I + Realistic R).

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行适合把「逻辑强 + 爱较真 + 能坐得住」凑一块的人——在表格海里把数据抠干净。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行最磨人的是「准」——一条漏填、一个错码都可能让整库返工。适合性子稳、爱较真、能在海量表格里找矛盾的人，逻辑和耐心是硬指标。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 偏好有条理、重规则、也愿钻研（常规 C + 研究 I + 现实 R）。

breadcrumb.label: Crushing, Grinding, And Polishing Machine Setters, Operators, And Tenders

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: This work suits people who combine steadiness, hands-on skill, and strict attention to safety. Particle size must be uniform and pass inspection, while equipment condition and warnings require balanced judgment.
riasec_fit_block.interest: This work develops intuition for equipment. Operators need process and particle-size knowledge plus the alertness to detect abnormalities before an incident. It suits steady, hands-on people willing to accept responsibility for safety and quality.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Prefers practical work, investigation, and structured routines (Realistic R + Investigative I + Conventional C).

breadcrumb.label: 机器铺设工、操作员、看护员

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行适合把「稳重 + 动手 + 对安全较真」凑一块的人——粒度要磨得匀也要过得检，设备和预警要平衡也要会看。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行最练「设备的直觉」——既要懂工艺和粒度，也要有把异常在出事前端出来的警觉。适合稳重、动手、愿意对安全和质量负责的人。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 偏好务实、也研究、也常规（现实 R + 研究 I + 常规 C）。

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: This field suits people with steady hands, calm focus, and exacting standards. Machines can complete most of the work, but the final manual corrections define the technician's value.
riasec_fit_block.interest: The satisfaction comes from precise coordination between hand and eye. A cold plaster model becomes a tooth that works for years. Patients rarely see the technician, but every bite reflects the quality of the craft.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Realistic (R) + Conventional (C) + Investigative (I)

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行适合「手上稳、心里静、又肯较真」的人——机器能做九十分，那十分的手工修正，就是技师存在的意义。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行的成就感在于「手到眼到」：一块冷冰冰的石膏模型，经你手变成一颗在嘴里能用几年的牙。患者看不见你，但每一口咬合都记着你的手艺。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 现实型 R + 常规型 C + 研究型 I

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: Environmental technician work can provide confidence and purpose if you value reliable data and solid field practice. Every result must be traceable, and every sampling location must withstand review.
riasec_fit_block.interest: The most rewarding part of this work is seeing data change an outcome. An abnormal river reading can lead regulators to uncover illegal discharge. Technology continues to improve, but careful people remain essential from sampling through final data reporting.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Investigative I + Realistic R + Conventional C

breadcrumb.label: 环境工程技师与技术员

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 如果你喜欢「数据和现场都踏实」的感觉——每一组数据都规范可溯、每一个采样点都经得起查，环境技师会让你找到职业的底气和意义。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行最有意思的是「你测的数据真的会改变什么」：你发现某条河断面数据异常，环保部门据此排查出偷排企业。技术在进步，但从采样到出数据的流程规范，永远需要认真的人。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 研究型 I + 现实型 R + 常规型 C

breadcrumb.label: First Line Supervisors Of Production And Operating Workers

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: This career suits people who combine practicality, accountability, and leadership. They stabilize the floor, own targets, and recover operations when production stops.
riasec_fit_block.interest: This career suits practical, accountable people who want to lead. They enjoy bringing rhythm to a disorganized production line and seeing the shift's output leave on time.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Prefers practical work, order, and leadership (Realistic R + Enterprising E + Conventional C).

breadcrumb.label: 生产运营工人一线主管

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行适合把「务实 + 扛事 + 会带人」凑一块的人——现场要稳，指标要背，断了就救火。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行适合务实、能扛事、又愿意带人的人。你喜欢把乱糟糟的产线理出节奏，看到一班货按时出，成就感很直接。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 偏好务实、重秩序也企业（现实型 R + 企业型 E + 事务型 C）。

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: This trade suits people who enjoy restoring old materials. A dull floor becoming bright provides immediate feedback on the quality of your work.
riasec_fit_block.interest: The satisfaction comes from the before-and-after result. A scratched floor becomes glossy through your work. People who enjoy hands-on craft, tolerate physical effort, and value visible completion can find steady fulfillment here.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Realistic (R) + Conventional (C) + Enterprising (E)

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行适合享受「旧物翻新」的人——地板从黯淡到发亮，就是对你手艺的即时反馈。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行的成就感在「翻新前后的对比」——一块磨花的地板经你的手变得锃亮，这种直观变化很满足。喜欢动手、能吃苦、享受手艺活完成感的人，会在这里找到踏实的乐趣。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 实际型 R + 事务型 C + 企业型 E

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: This work suits people who treat a landscape as their own responsibility and take pride when others appreciate a well-maintained lawn.
riasec_fit_block.interest: One of the best parts of this field is seeing the result. A disordered lawn becomes neat and attractive through your work, and looking back at it at the end of the day provides a satisfaction that office work often cannot.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Realistic (R) + Conventional (C) + Enterprising (E)

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行适合把「养好一片绿地」当自己事的人——看到自己打理的草坪被夸漂亮，比什么都开心。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行最舒服的地方在于「工作成果看得见」：一片杂乱的草坪，在你手里变得整齐漂亮，傍晚收工时回头看一眼，那种满足感是办公室给不了的。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 实际型 R + 事务型 C + 企业型 E

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: This work suits people who combine conviction, negotiation, and accountability. Rules must be sound, while issues and votes require human judgment.
riasec_fit_block.interest: This field develops consensus building amid conflict. It requires policy and data literacy and the ability to mediate among stakeholders, fitting people with clear positions who speak well and accept responsibility for public issues.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Enterprising, investigative, and social (Enterprising E + Investigative I + Social S).

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行适合把「主张 + 协商 + 能扛责」凑一块的人——规则要定好，议题和选票都靠人理。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行最练「在冲突里找共识」——既要懂政策和数据算得清，也要能在多方利益里斡旋。适合有主张、能说、又愿意为公共议题扛责的人，也享受推动一条法律落地的成就感。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 偏好主导、钻研、也务实（企业 E + 研究 I + 社会 S）。

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: This career suits people who combine sustained screen focus, care, and exacting standards. Sparing healthy organs matters above everything else.
riasec_fit_block.interest: This career's quiet precision centers on millimeters. A difference of two millimeters can expose the spinal cord to additional harm. It suits careful people who can focus on screens and insist on accurate calculations.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Investigative, conventional, and practical (Investigative I + Conventional C + Realistic R).

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行适合把「坐得住屏 + 细心 + 较真」凑一块的人——好器官不受累比啥都重要。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行最较真也最安静的是「毫米」——差两毫米，脊髓就多受一份罪。适合坐得住屏、又细心、愿意为「算得准」较真的人。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 偏好钻研、守规矩、也愿意动手（研究 I + 常规 C + 实用 R）。

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: This field suits people who combine composure + goal orientation + the ability to bear trust. Plans must sell and endure, requiring a balance of numbers and relationships with strong communication.
riasec_fit_block.interest: This field develops judgment with numbers. Advisors must understand products and calculations while building long-term trust through conversation. It suits outgoing, composed people who accept responsibility for results and enjoy the full journey from first contact to enduring commitment.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Prefers practical, routine, and helping work (Enterprising E + Conventional C + Social S).

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行适合把「稳重 + 目标感 + 能扛信任」凑一块的人——规划要卖得出也要卖得久，数字和关系要平衡也要会聊。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行最练「数字里的分寸」——既要懂产品算得清，也要有把客户聊成长期信任的人情。适合外向、稳重、又愿意对结果负责的人，也享受从破冰到托付的全过程。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 偏好务实、务实常规、也助人（企业 E + 常规 C + 社会 S）。

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: This field suits people who combine steady hands + attention to detail + basic theoretical understanding. Micron-level accuracy, precise parameters, and equipment knowledge all matter.
riasec_fit_block.interest: This field depends on steady hands + patience + understanding principles. Optical components are delicate and tolerances tiny; a one-micron adjustment creates enormous differences. It suits meticulous people who enjoy equipment and tolerate cleanroom monotony.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Prefers hands-on operation, investigation, and compliance (Realistic R + Investigative I + Conventional C).

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行适合把「手稳 + 心细 + 懂点原理」凑一块的人——微米不差、参数要准、设备要懂。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行最吃「手稳 + 坐得住 + 懂点原理」。光学元件娇贵、容差极小，调一微米差之千里。适合性子细、爱琢磨设备、又能忍洁净室枯燥的人。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 偏好动手操作、也钻研与守规（现实 R + 研究 I + 常规 C）。

breadcrumb.label: Ushers, Lobby Attendants, And Ticket Takers

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: This field suits people who combine an outgoing nature, patience, and physical stamina. Guidance must be clear, incidents must be handled calmly, and service and order must be balanced with a smile.
riasec_fit_block.interest: This field most strongly develops grace in small interactions. You must remain patient in noisy crowds and explain seats and routes clearly. It suits outgoing, attentive people comfortable with standing and rotating shifts who enjoy bringing order to chaos.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Prefers helping, practical work, and following rules (Social S + Realistic R + Conventional C).

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行适合把「外向 + 耐心 + 能站」凑一块的人——引导要讲得清，突发要稳得住，服务和秩序要平衡也要会笑。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行最练「小事里的体面」——要在人多嘈杂时保持耐心，也要把座位和动线讲清楚。适合外向、细心、不怕站立和轮班的人，也享受把混乱理顺的那一下。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 偏好照护、务实、也守规则（社会 S + 务实 R + 常规 C）。
